title: astrology lunar-eclipse: the params of scene.play

x.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, east to the left.

y.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, north up.

on.description: When this step shows: 0.3 + 5.4 i / 14 for step i.

off.description: When the next step takes over (the last one: 6).

img.description: moon-red while this step is inside the umbra, else moon.

path.description: The Moon against the centre of the Earth's shadow in 14 steps, 3.2 hours either side of the peak. Scale: 0.8 over the penumbra's radius.

umbra.description: The radius of the Earth's full shadow.

pen.description: The radius of the Earth's partial shadow (0.8 at this scale).

moon_r.description: The Moon's radius at the same scale.
